metadata.description: Human-maintained categorization and priority policy for YouTube source channels.

priority_order.P-2: Highest-priority expert source; any upload is urgent regardless of length.
priority_order.P-1: Above-P0 top-tier source; any in-window upload is handled before normal P0.
priority_order.P0: High-cadence fast-update radar or official primary source; scan every run and transcript every in-window video.
priority_order.P1: Strong AI/product source; scan every run, transcript in-window videos when relevant.
priority_order.P2: Context, strategy, interviews, or regional perspective; scan normally, summarize selectively.
priority_order.P3: Low-frequency or broad tech context; keep for coverage, lower urgency.
